04/28/2026
            IN THE COURT OF CRIMINAL APPEALS OF TENNESSEE
                             AT NASHVILLE
                                      January 13, 2026 Session

                 CARRINGTON OWENS v. STATE OF TENNESSEE

                  Appeal from the Circuit Court for Montgomery County
                   No. 2016-CR-497 William R. Goodman, III, Judge

results.syllabus: Carrington Owens, Petitioner, appeals from the denial of post-conviction relief from Petitioner's convictions for four counts of rape of a child, twenty-three counts of especially aggravated sexual exploitation of a minor, and twelve counts of aggravated sexual battery of a child less than thirteen years of age and his effective thirty-seven-year sentence. On appeal, Petitioner contends that the post-conviction court erred by denying relief on his ineffective assistance of counsel claims. Discerning no error, we affirm the judgment of the post-conviction court.
